output.summary: Agency spend growth is about 77% volume and 23% rate, so the market-price story (H1) is contradicted. The evidence fits a reinforcing loop. Vacancies raise agency share. Agency RNs cannot take charge or precept, so those duties and buddy orientation fall on permanent RNs. Exhaustion and resignations rise about two quarters later, and vacancies grow again. The 4 West pilot against matched units supports the causal link, and the resignation rise predates St. Brennan's. Pay matters but is not the primary driver. The proposed bonus, funded by cutting charge and preceptor differentials, would worsen the loop (the 2025 bonus did not lower vacancies). Extend the 4 West model, renegotiate the agency escalator as a secondary lever, and defer outsourcing and the agency bar until the funnel and adjusted falls data are in.
